theoretical_viva_explanation: Feature Interaction Constraints strictly forbid decision tree branches from splitting on features belonging to different domain groups. In Standard XGBoost, 65.7% of all parent-child splits cross between functional domains (e.g. Header timestamps interacting with File Entropy). In Constrained XGBoost, exactly 0.0% of splits cross groups. This mathematically isolates functional domains, preventing polymorphic malware mutations in one domain (e.g. timestamp stomping) from undermining decision rules in another (e.g. entropy).
